name: Budget Variance Analyzer
summary: Calculates budget-vs-actual variances per line and in total, and marks each favourable or unfavourable for its line type.
description: Reads your budget and actual figures per line (revenue or expense), and calculates each line's variance in money and percent, whether it is favourable (revenue above budget, expense below budget), totals for revenue, expenses and net, and the largest unfavourable line. Sums are exact to the cent. Budget Variance Review (a separate workflow) writes commentary on variances you have already computed; this one computes them. Who it's for: finance leads, founders and budget owners preparing a monthly or quarterly review. Limitations: amounts must be in one currency and period, entered to the cent; a line with a zero budget has no variance %.
problems: I need to calculate our budget variances this month
Which costs are over budget and by how much
Compare actual spend against the budget

inputs.label: Budget and actuals
inputs.description: One line per item: name, revenue or expense, budget and actual.
inputs.example:
Subscriptions (revenue): budget 50,000, actual 55,000
Software (expense): budget 8,000, actual 11,200

outputs.label: Calculated results
outputs.description: Results with units, formulas, assumptions and warnings, from the registered calculation.

outputs.label: Explanation
outputs.description: What the results mean, with numbers taken only from the calculation.

execution.system: You are an analyst explaining calculated results to a business decision-maker. Be concrete and brief.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what the results mean for the decision, using only calculated numbers.
summary.title: Summary

text.description: One point. Numbers only from the calculated results.

steps.name: Read your data
steps.responsibility: Copy your figures into the calculation's input exactly as written.
steps.prompt: Read each line: its name, whether it is revenue or expense, the budget and the actual. Copy amounts exactly as written (without currency symbols).

steps.name: Calculate
steps.responsibility: Runs the registered budget_variance@1 calculation. All numbers in the result come from here.

steps.name: Explain
steps.responsibility: Explains the calculated results; adds no numbers of its own.
steps.prompt: Explain the overall position and the lines that matter most, especially unfavourable ones, and what to ask their owners. Mention every warning.

steps.name: Check explanation
steps.responsibility: Every number in the explanation matches the calculated results or your inputs.

criteria.description: Every number in the summary comes from the calculation or your inputs.
Every number in the key points comes from the calculation or your inputs.
The summary is 90 words or fewer.
